scope: Broaden DWG/DXF comparison with LibreDWG's current AC1027+ AcDs reader route and release/security record, plus the documented FreeCAD converter and DXF-importer handoff.

method.kind: Primary-source documentation, source, release-note, and issue review
method.qualificationRule: A declared route, source function, successful process exit, entity count, or nonempty carrier is not semantic or end-to-end support evidence. Pin and inspect every conversion boundary and compare exact object/owner outcomes.

evidence.observed: Current source contains a named R2007+ AcDs section-read path and an AcDs private parser; the manual identifies AcDsPrototype_1b as a datastore used mostly for binary ACIS blobs. Separately, open issue #1411 reports that LibreDWG 0.14.8593 loses an ezdxf-generated AC1032 SAB carrier during both conversion directions while retaining REGION entities. The source path and the release-specific failure report coexist, showing that parser entry-point presence does not prove handle-to-record association or end-to-end geometry preservation.
doesNotEstablish: that the issue reproduces on current LibreDWG master or any other release
that libdxfrw has the same failure
correct AcDs owner/index/page semantics for every profile
valid ACIS topology or geometric equivalence
evidence.planUse: Keep LibreDWG as an optional, exact-revision, composed-stage reader/converter comparator. On the existing locally generated AC1032 case, capture source section inventory, entity handle and has_ds_data state, record join, payload hash, output carrier and independent shape result. Do not accept the issue body as a local reproduction or use the peer as the sole AcDs/semantic oracle.

evidence.observed: The 0.14.1 release notes record security fixes involving decompression buffer capacity versus logical size, stale object pointers, unvalidated page-map offsets, section-size multiplication overflow, and other malformed-input bounds. This supplies concrete hostile-input categories for DWG page/section handling, complementing the existing local checked-arithmetic and hostile-page plan.
doesNotEstablish: that an unrelated peer fix should be ported verbatim
that peer fuzzing or sanitizer results cover this codebase
evidence.planUse: Map the categories to existing parser bounds/resource owners rather than adding a generic security epic. Keep each implementation slice to its fast focused strict build and generated regression; reserve broader sanitizer/fuzz and full-suite work for the planned composed/scheduled gates.

evidence.observed: FreeCAD documentation describes DWG as an external-converter workflow and names LibreDWG, ODA, and QCAD converter choices; it cautions that LibreDWG may miss entities or fidelity. The DXF preferences distinguish the faster C++ importer from the legacy Python importer and say the newer C++ path has fewer features. Thus a FreeCAD result is a composed converter-plus-selected-importer outcome, not a direct libdxfrw read. The stock documented path remains a 2D handoff and cannot establish ACIS/ACDS B-rep semantics.
doesNotEstablish: that a tested FreeCAD installation selected the intended converter or importer
that DXF output preserved every DWG object or reference
native Linux/Windows qualification from documentation alone
evidence.planUse: For the existing native consumer gate, record exact FreeCAD build, selected converter and resolved executable, DXF importer mode, process status, fresh output signature/version, per-handle/field expectations, and resulting document objects. Retain the 2D compatibility gate; keep 3D geometry qualification on a separate capable consumer/kernel route.

implementationReadinessChanges: Do not block local parser/writer slices on LibreDWG, FreeCAD, or a geometry kernel being unavailable.
Pin the exact LibreDWG source/release before differential comparison; keep source-level route inventory separate from runtime and semantic results.
At a composed FreeCAD checkpoint, make converter selection and DXF importer mode explicit and observable; do not infer them from UI defaults or automatic fallback.
Reuse current bounded-arithmetic, truncation, hostile-page, and fail-closed tests. Do not increase per-slice suite frequency; schedule the broader fuzz/sanitizer gate at its existing checkpoint.
